localContext: Elmhurst garages face specific challenges. Many homes, from the Brick Georgians in College View to Tudors in Yorkfield, feature original detached garages. These older structures and their doors endure decades of Chicago weather extremes. Rebuilt lots often have new oversized attached garages, where heavy doors put extra strain on components. Moist air, road salt, and cold temperatures in winter accelerate wear on springs, hinges, and weather seals. Given Salt Creek's history, Elmhurst owners prioritize a tight bottom seal. A well-maintained door helps protect against water intrusion at the slab level. Regular tune-ups are essential for these local conditions, ensuring your garage door operates correctly and protects your home.

process.description: We examine all moving parts, including springs, cables, rollers, and track alignment.
We apply garage-door-specific lubricant and make necessary adjustments to hinges and other hardware.
We check for worn hinges, worn weather seal (bottom rubber), and loose fastener hardware. We replace parts as needed.
After service, we perform a balance test and ensure the safety-reverse system functions correctly.
